summary.tldr: Requires courts to treat assaults on health service providers and first responders as aggravating factors at sentencing.
what_it_does: Requires courts, when sentencing for certain assault offences, to consider it an aggravating circumstance if the victim was a person who provides health services, including personal care services, or a first responder doing their duty.
summary.background: The bill adds a new section to the Criminal Code sentencing rules for certain assault offences.
